scenarios.name: Already-queued confirmed removal delivered after captured Correction

attempts.result: In an actual Correction, staged D10 three-byte replacement then preopened clean C10 saved 3-byte picker. Actual Save admitted 202; controlled provider paused original POST. While scoped native wrapper inert, a trusted pointer action targeted Remove bounds; passive trusted click listener stayed false and removal stayed absent. Released original POST in finally; Correction 3 completed. Prior two Corrections equal; Submission hash unchanged; exact C10 receipt unchanged and corrected D10 retained three bytes.

scenarios.verdict: Queued confirmation ordering NOT REACHED. Stop before repeating deterministic inert boundary. Native Remove is only a local candidate (picker lines 337–351), and native footer emits pending-file-remove only on confirmation (lines 388–402). Dirty pre-capture candidate is refused; ordinary post-capture user action cannot activate inert picker. Neither result proves already-queued delivery. Need genuine scheduler/event evidence with the real emitted confirmation; do not inject/replay, bypass inert, or count controlled HTTP/host tests as native proof.
